name: Eleventy (11ty / Build Awesome) Static Site Generator
free_limit: MIT-licensed local static-site generator supporting Markdown, HTML and multiple template engines; no license fee or vendor-imposed local site/build quota.
watch_out: Eleventy is build software, not free hosted web space. Hosting, CDN, domains, CI runners, bandwidth and plugins may cost extra. Upstream now uses the Build Awesome name/repository; @11ty/eleventy remains a compatible installation path; check version and plugin compatibility.
